controls.attack: a small app change outside every locked path
controls.source: the suite's own control

controls.attack: a docs change outside the design rules
controls.source: the suite's own control

controls.attack: a change to a test that holds no control
controls.source: the suite's own control

controls.attack: a change to an app's own src/ (the engine's source locks stand aside in a managed app)
controls.source: the suite's own control (#665)

controls.attack: a planned task whose PR changes only what its plan lists
controls.source: the suite's own control (outside-plan cases)

controls.attack: a new test, with the change read for a weakened test, lint or guard
controls.source: the suite's own control (weakening cases)

controls.attack: a small app change outside every locked path, decided by the coordinator's own mergeDecisionFor
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow cases)

controls.attack: a small app change the evaluator passed, then the harness merged the default branch into it (a merge-in)
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-merge-in-rejection-carried: the PASS is carried across the merge-in, and the change is measured from the merged default branch)

controls.attack: a small app change while the default branch has moved past the PR's base with an unrelated commit
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-marked-table-grown: a moved tip alone holds nothing)

controls.attack: a small app change whose branch merged the moved default branch in itself (an unrelated commit there)
controls.source: the suite's own control (default-branch-tip.json: a tip merged in by the PR alone holds nothing)

controls.attack: a stale PR that only adds a rule to a test the default branch marked as a lint test after this PR's base
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-lint-mark: only a rule taken out of a lint test marked on the tip holds it)

controls.attack: a lint test made on the default branch after this PR's base; the PR merges the default branch in, then only adds a rule to it
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-lint-file-only-at-tip: only a rule taken out of a tip-only lint test holds it)

controls.attack: a stale PR (it never merged the default branch in) that edits a file elsewhere, beside a table the default branch marked never-shrink since
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-mark-taken-out-after-merge: a head older than the mark keeps it through the merge)

controls.attack: a stale PR (it never merged the default branch in) that adds a line elsewhere in a file whose table the default branch re-marked from never-grow to never-shrink since
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-mark-kind-changed-at-tip: a head older than a tip mark of another kind keeps it through the merge, so the mark isn't taken out); #1056 round 6 review N9

controls.attack: a planned task whose PR changes an auth file its plan lists, in a repo whose review.yaml puts auth at L2
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-outside-plan-auth-not-held: only the plan check holds that case)

controls.attack: a planned task whose approved plan lists no files, and whose PR changes only an ordinary app file
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-outside-plan-empty-plan: only the unplanned auth file holds that case)

controls.attack: a planned task whose own plan lists the auth file it changes, while another task's later plan doesn't, in a repo whose review.yaml puts auth at L2
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-outside-plan-another-tasks-plan: only this task's plan decides)

controls.attack: a planned task whose plan lists the auth file by its path and an ordinary file by its file name only, in a repo whose review.yaml puts auth at L2
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-outside-plan-entry-by-file-name: only the auth file's entry holds that case)

controls.attack: a planned task whose plan lists the auth file by its path and the app folder by a glob, in a repo whose review.yaml puts auth at L2
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-outside-plan-entry-with-glob: only the auth file's entry holds that case)

controls.attack: a small app change on an issue with a label that names no risk
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-money-path-label: only the money-path label holds that case)

controls.attack: an app change while the money-path list on the default branch, moved since this PR's base, names other folders only
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-money-path-list-moved-on-default-branch: only a listed path holds that case)

controls.attack: a change in a top-level folder the base already has, with no seed folders
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-new-top-level-module: only a folder the base lacks holds that case)

controls.attack: a change that deletes a 20-line app file
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-big-deletion: only the size holds that case)

controls.attack: a small app change with this task's always-PASS verdict on its head, then another task's verdict on the same head that rejects the patch
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-verdict-of-another-task: only this task's verdict decides)

controls.attack: a change that adds 20 small app files, exactly review.yaml's max_files
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-too-many-files: only a count over the limit holds that case)

controls.attack: a small app change on an issue with a label that names no risk, while another issue is seen later labelled money-path
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-money-path-label-another-issue-seen-later: only this issue's labels count)
